# PDUP model review: Coulee Solar + Storage (synthetic)

SYN-0002 · Stage 2 · 210 MW solar · POI Substation 902S 138 kV (fictional)

**Outcome: Accepted** (0 deficiencies, 0 clarifications)

## Summary

Review of Coulee Solar + Storage (synthetic) is complete.  
The model review outcome is accepted.  
No findings were identified.  
Every rule passed.

_Summary drafted by: local LLM; findings below are rule-based._

## Study results

- Reactive capability at the POI: +82.1 / -176.2 Mvar at 204.6 MW against +/-67.2 Mvar required.
- Short-circuit ratio at the POI: 11.4; collector fault level 23.2 kA (switchgear 31.5 kA).
- Most sensitive input for the POI reactive margin: Inverter reactive limit (-10% / +10%: +4.6 to +25.6 Mvar).

_Synthetic project and data, produced by an automated first-pass review; engineering judgement and AESO's PDUP checklist govern._

findings.message: The AC power flow does not reach a valid solution at full output with the data as submitted. It solves to a valid operating point once GSU 2 kv_lv is set to 0.69.
findings.action: Correct the model so the case solves from a flat start.
findings.impact: No steady-state, short-circuit or dynamic study can be run on this case.
findings.probable_cause: Root cause isolated by re-solving with each suspected correction on its own.

findings.message: At 197 MW the plant delivers +23 / -104 Mvar at the POI; 0.95 power factor needs +/-65 Mvar.
findings.action: Add reactive capability (inverter MVA, capacitor or STATCOM) or justify the shortfall.
findings.impact: The facility would not meet the reactive power requirement at the POI.

findings.message: LV winding is 690 kV but bus G2 is 0.69 kV.
findings.action: Correct the winding or bus voltage.
findings.impact: An off-nominal ratio of this size distorts every voltage in the plant.
findings.probable_cause: The winding voltage looks like it was entered in volts: 690 -> 0.69 kV.

findings.message: Impedance 5.56% on 180 MVA is outside 6-15% for a main transformer.
findings.action: Confirm the test-report impedance and the MVA base it is stated on.
findings.impact: Transformer impedance drives voltage regulation, reactive losses and fault levels.
findings.probable_cause: The value looks like it is on the 100 MVA system base: 5.56% x 180/100 = 10.0% on the transformer's own base, which is typical.

findings.message: X = 1.428 ohm/km, outside 0.08-0.25 ohm/km for 34.5 kV cable.
findings.action: Confirm X for the conductor and length, in p.u. on 100 MVA.
findings.impact: Power flow, short-circuit and stability results depend directly on this impedance.
findings.probable_cause: Likely ohms typed into the p.u. field: read that way it is 0.120 ohm/km, a normal value (0.09074 p.u. on the study base).

findings.element: WTG group 1 REECA1, WTG group 2 REECA1
findings.message: Imax = 0.9 p.u. cannot carry rated P (0.900) with the required Q (0.297): needs 0.948.
findings.action: Raise Imax to the converter's current rating or justify the limit.
findings.impact: The model would cut active or reactive current at full output, misstating fault ride-through.

findings.element: WTG group 1 REPCA1, WTG group 2 REPCA1
findings.action: Set the droop to the plant's frequency-response setting (for 5%, Ddn = 20).
findings.impact: Over-frequency response would be too weak in frequency studies.

findings.message: The YNd1 main transformer has a delta low-voltage winding and no grounding transformer is modelled on MV.
findings.action: Add the collector grounding transformer (impedance and connection) or confirm the grounding method.
findings.impact: Without a ground source the collector is ungrounded: ground-fault currents, overvoltages and protection studies are wrong.

findings.message: Winter rating 400 MVA is below the summer rating 450 MVA; cooler winter air should allow more.
findings.impact: Summer studies would use an optimistic limit.
findings.probable_cause: The summer and winter values appear to be swapped.

findings.message: Bus COL3 (34.5 kV) is not connected to the POI.
findings.action: Connect the bus or remove it from the case.
findings.impact: An islanded bus is dropped from the study and hides missing equipment.

findings.message: Reactive range -30 to 30 Mvar is below +/-33 Mvar (0.33 x Pmax) at the terminals.
findings.action: Provide the capability curve at full output.
findings.impact: The plant may not meet the power-factor requirement at the POI (see PF-02).

findings.element: WTG group 1 REGCA1, WTG group 2 REGCA1
findings.message: Tg = 0.005 s is shorter than 4 integration steps (0.0167 s).
findings.action: Set Tg to 0 to bypass it, or to at least 0.017 s.
findings.impact: Time constants below a few steps make the simulation numerically unstable or step-size dependent.

findings.message: At the required operating points: Main transformer loaded 112% (export), Main transformer loaded 112% (unity), Main transformer loaded 116% (absorb).
findings.action: Review voltage control settings and equipment ratings.
findings.impact: Equipment would operate outside its ratings while meeting the requirement.

findings.message: Short-circuit ratio 2.8 (560 MVA / 200 MW) is below 3: a weak connection point.
findings.action: Provide a validated EMT (PSCAD) model; an EMT study will be required.
findings.impact: Phasor-domain (PSS/E) models can miss control instability at low system strength.

findings.message: Each value passes its range check, but the combination is more unusual than every one of the 600 accepted 34.5 kV cable models: X high (+3.5 robust sd), R low (-3.0 robust sd), B low (-2.8 robust sd).
findings.action: Confirm the conductor and cable data sheet values together.
findings.impact: A plausible-looking but wrong impedance passes every single-value check and skews every study.
